title: Preserve identity when applying supported definition revisions
statement: The Engineering model authoring Module shall preserve the resolved entity identity through supported same-entity name, location, and definition revisions, submitting the explicit candidate and base state for checked retention and reporting the actual resulting outcome.

what.problem: A rename or move can accidentally replace identity or alter semantic containment.
what.desired_outcome: Supported revisions evolve the same entity while existing identity references keep their designation.

why.rationale: SR-003 separates stable identity from changing labels, locations, and authored content.

conditions: An authorized same-entity rename, location change, or definition edit is requested.

contexts: The authoring responsibility using IF-001 and IF-002.

how.approach: Resolve the original subject, form the same-identity candidate, check its identity conditions, and submit it with the expected base to retention.

how_much.scope: Same-entity edits within the governed model and preserved containment parentage; splits, merges, identity reuse, and semantic reparenting are outside this operation.

acceptance_criteria: For supported name, location, and definition changes, the retained result has the original identity and existing identity references designate it.

A proposed identity replacement, conflicting target, unsupported split/merge, or containment-parent change receives an explicit unsupported/conflict outcome rather than a successful same-entity revision.
A changed base state or candidate must be reconciled before using previous findings; do not overwrite an intervening definition using stale selection.
Incomplete or failed retention is reported with known effects; preservation of identity does not renew approval or evidence applicability.

sources.basis: Derived from SR-003 for the proposed MOD-002 responsibility and IR-001 scenario walkthrough. Acceptance criteria are intended observations, not executed verification or an approval.
